class.name: wisco_ethercat_ros2_hw/SafeCommandController
class.description: Forwards Float64MultiArray commands on ~/commands to one command interface per joint, with a command timeout, per-joint magnitude limits, soft position limits, NaN rejection and a stop on deactivate.

class.name: wisco_ethercat_ros2_hw/ArmController
class.description: The arm's RT loop: Mode P (CSP target + 0x60B2 gravity/friction torque offset) and Mode T (CST host PD + feedforward), Pinocchio gravity from robot_description plus the calibration file, bumpless mode switching, and a 50 ms watchdog that drops to gravity comp + damping. Commands on ~/command, state on ~/state.
